description: Hi, <name>.  Remember Tinkee Steamboil?  Well, she remembers you!  She sent me a message to keep an eye out for you, because... she needs your help again.  I think it has something to do with her studies on dragons.
You should speak to her in the Burning Steppes, at the Flame Crest.
completion: Felnok was right! I do need your help again, and this time... it's going to be really dangerous.
